datasets.title: Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba Education Facilities (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['amenity'] IN ('kindergarten', 'school', 'college', 'university') OR tags['building'] IN ('kindergarten', 'school', 'college', 'university') Features may have these attributes: name name:en amenity building operator:type capacity:persons addr:full addr:city source This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_bes_education_facilities]
datasets.details: OpenStreetMap data is crowd sourced and cannot be considered to be exhaustive

lineage.description: Education facilities in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba were extracted from OpenStreetMap using amenity and building tags matching kindergarten, school, college, and university classifications. Features were exported in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, KML) with attributes including facility name, operator type, capacity, and address information.
